$Comment: Gunter summoned by the Ice King: hostile, unlike the neutral AT_Gunter. Variant of vanilla Template_Predator built like the vanilla Fox (bite attack and InteractionVars); attack: Root_AT_Gunter_Attack alternates AT_Gunter_Attack_1/_2 (the fox Fox_Bite hit with the custom Attack / Attack2 animations, set AT_Gunter); damage from the Bite_Damage var below. 2026-10-21 (playtest: flank me, don't all come from the same angle): combat movement of vanilla Wolf_Black (also a Template_Predator Variant without CAE): CombatDirectWeight 0 (never charge straight in, was 5), CombatStrafeWeight 10 (was 5: circle left/right around the player), CombatBackOffAfterAttack true with CombatBackOffDistanceRange [3, 5] (step back after a bite; max must stay under CombatBehaviorDistance), CombatBehaviorDistance 6 (was 5), CombatMovingRelativeSpeed 0.6 (slower while circling, was 0.8). 2026-10-21 (playtest: mostly wing slaps): Root_AT_Gunter_Attack walks a 14-step order of Slap/Slap2/headbutt (AT_Gunter_Attack_2)/belly lunge (AT_Gunter_Attack_1), each with its own hit (AT_Gunter_Slap/Belly/Headbutt_Damage: 5/9/13), so the Bite_Damage var below is no longer used by his attacks (kept for anything inheriting Fox_Bite). Not CombatTurns: it only works inside one flock, and summoned Gunters have none (joining the king's flock would make the king's ray hold fire when a Gunter is in the line). 2026-10-21 (Gunter bowling): AdditionalCombatBehaviorMacroElement = Component_AT_Gunter_Slide, a belly slide at the player picked now and then among his combat movements (3-6 blocks away).
